name: Slothfulness
overview: Scripture, particularly in Proverbs 6:6-11, admonishes the slothful to observe the ant’s diligent provision for the future despite having no overseer. The passage highlights the danger of excessive sleep and idleness, warning that such slothfulness brings sudden poverty and want like an armed intruder. This teaching calls believers to wisdom and responsible stewardship as expressions of godly living.
